observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a silver/grey iPhone with a triple-camera module and Apple logo. A white sticker with text is affixed to the back, partially readable as 'iPhone 15 Pro', 'Capacity: 256GB', 'Color: Space Black', 'Serial No: ...', and a barcode. The background shows a sign with 'DANNY TUNEZ' and 'IT' logo.
Photo 1: Side view of the same iPhone, showing the volume buttons and power button. The phone appears to have a metallic finish. The same 'DANNY TUNEZ' sign is in the background.

Photo 2: Front view of the iPhone screen displaying the 'Parts & Service' section of the Settings app. It shows 'SERVICE HISTORY' with 'Genuine' status for 'Display'. The time on the phone is 10:19. The background sign is again visible.

claims.claim: iPhone 15 Pro available for buy now pay later
claims.evidence: The seller's text states this, but no proof of financing or payment plan is shown in the photos. The photos only show the phone and a shop sign.
Photo 2 shows the 'Parts & Service' screen with 'Genuine' status for the display, indicating Apple's verification. The sticker in photo 0 also lists Apple model details.
Photo 0 sticker reads 'Color: Space Black'. The phone's back appears dark grey/silver, consistent with Space Black finish.

risks.risk: The phone may have been repaired with non-genuine parts (e.g., battery, camera, logic board) not shown in the 'Parts & Service' screen.
risks.proof: A full screenshot of the 'Parts & Service' screen showing all components (battery, camera, logic board, etc.) and their status (Genuine or Not Genuine).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having non-genuine parts, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The phone may have water damage or internal issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the phone being powered on, camera functioning, and a full diagnostic test (e.g., screen, speakers, mic, charging port, buttons).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or with hidden defects.

risks.risk: The serial number on the sticker may be fake or mismatched with the actual device.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the phone's settings screen (Settings > General > About) to verify it matches the sticker in photo 0.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially counterfeit or stolen, which drastically reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear screenshot of the 'Parts & Service' screen showing all components and their status.
A video showing the phone powered on, camera working, and all buttons functioning.
A clear photo of the serial number from the phone's settings screen to match the sticker.
response.reason: While the phone appears to be an iPhone 15 Pro with 256GB and Space Black color, and the 'Parts & Service' screen shows the display is genuine, critical risks remain unproven: other components may be non-genuine, the serial number may be mismatched, and internal damage is not visible. These risks must be verified before pricing.
